messages.subject: Distance 7.3 release
parts:
Dear Distance Users,


We are happy to announce the release of Distance 7.3!


The most significant addition to this version is the Shape Import Wizard which will help you import shapefiles and set your project up for generating designs.


Example 4 in Chapter 3 - Getting Started of the Distance Sampling Manual now guides you through the import of the Mexico shapefiles for the global and stratum layers. In addition, there is further documentation in the Program Reference Appendix.


We have also made some updates to the simulation engine and minor changes to dsm.


Best wishes,


Distance Development Team

Centre for Research into Ecological & Environmental Modelling

University of St. Andrews
